name: hooks-library
description: Hooks that make a rule land mechanically instead of asking an agent to remember it. Ships style-reminder, a UserPromptSubmit hook that reads the project's active output style and puts it back in front of the agent every time the owner sends a message, so voice instructions delivered once at session start never go stale. Built after measuring real transcripts showed those rules are stated clearly in several places and broken in a quarter to over half of all messages anyway.
